scope: Single bulk research adjudication of all 18 remaining owner-handpicked low-resolution artwork records; no gallery changes

status_definition.OFFICIAL_MUSEUM_PUBLICATION_NO_ACCESSION: Institution itself publishes same artist, title and holding, but no catalogue ID or image comparison; eligible for evidence-supported identity metric under existing phase29/30 convention
status_definition.ORIGINAL_MUSEUM_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_TRACEABLE_: Original photo attribution traces to legacy institution-managed photo service, but inaccessible historic URL does not independently settle object accession or exact current catalogue record
status_definition.others: Provisional/hold until direct current object record or another authoritative published inventory can be retrieved

reviewed_records.title: Bruno van Hollebeke — Saint Jerome
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Bruges inventory crosswalk links Bruno van Hollebeke to 0000.GRO0420.I, but a Commons image at the same accession is attributed to Anaïs Bouvy; must inspect museum record/photograph before deciding. Do NOT silently select either.

reviewed_records.title: Master of the Legend of Saint Augustine — Episcopal Saint Enthroned
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Selected photo originally from official KIK-IRPA Friedländer record 1403, but direct source now inaccessible. BALaT object 152399 secondary crosswalk connects to St Nicholas altarpiece, also independently handpicked as RECENT575::180 (other attribution); preserve panel/image distinctions.

reviewed_records.title: Philippe de Champaigne — Visitation, Geneva
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Geneva MAH accession in independent crosswalk; the selected image may depict the modello, not separate full-size canvas in Villeneuve-les-Avignon or Princeton painting. Current MAH catalogue/authorship not fetched.
reviewed_records.possible_attribution_note: Modello after or workshop uncertainty; do not flatten to definitive original

reviewed_records.title: Nicolas Mignard — Virgin and Child
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Marseille museum's own permanent-collection overview explicitly names Nicolas Mignard, Vierge à l'Enfant. Matches owner-selected Commons attribution/title/holding. Exact accession, composition-level museum image comparison and rights still pending.

reviewed_records.title: Jacob Jordaens — Saint Matthew with two apostles
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Commons names exact Lille P85, Joconde 000PE016876 and RKD 12269 and RMN photographic source; direct official catalogue unavailable. Avoid confusing companion apostle paintings P82–P84.

reviewed_records.title: Mocking of Christ — school/attributed Hendrick ter Brugghen
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Historic Lille painting catalogue crosswalk says P48 / Joconde 000PE017694. A 2024 restoration displayed it as autograph although historically classed school/copy. Keep attribution review open; do NOT confuse with Cranach school mocking P740.
reviewed_records.historic_catalogue: Catalogue des tableaux du musée de Lille (1893), work 258 as indexed

reviewed_records.title: Anonymous — Deposition from the Cross, Dijon
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Selected original described anonymous 18th-century 58.5 x 42.3 cm oil on canvas. Dijon Jean Jouvenet CA336 and Guillon-Lethière 1007/S48-P are DIFFERENT paintings by size, attribution and period; do not borrow inventory. Original Commons photo exact official object unlocated.

reviewed_records.title: William-Adolphe Bouguereau — Return of Tobias
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Handpicked image and Bouguereau 2010 catalogue identify 1856 painting and Dijon CA232; Dijon historical museum catalogue appears to name purchase after Dijon exhibition but large PDF not independently inspected. Musée d'Orsay Salon catalogue also corroborates title/artist, not accession.
reviewed_records.museum_historical_citation: Catalogue historique et descriptif du Musée de Dijon; retrieval/screenshot pending; do not claim direct inspected

reviewed_records.title: David Teniers the Younger after Palma il Giovane — Dead Christ supported by an Angel
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: The selected original and secondary national-catalogue crosswalk identify MG2405, Joconde 09940006297 and 'after Palma il Giovane' miniature c.1656. Direct Grenoble/POP museum record could not be fetched. Do not conflate historic Theatrum pictorium engraving with original painting.

reviewed_records.title: Jacob Willemsz de Wet — Jesus Preaching on Lake Tiberias
reviewed_records.evidence_and_next_action: Wikidata/Commons crosswalk points to Magnin inventory 1938 E 294 and Joconde 50110001768. Exact museum record inaccessible. Preserve as provisional.

rights_photographic_policy: Never infer exact-photo reuse permission from historical metadata, institution text or Commons PDArt tag. Keep all image upgrades on hold until exact image, rights, crop and colour fidelity review.
preservation: No public application, Prayer or Calendar assets touched
